text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp to build up strength has arrived.
Summer is a great opportunity for Umamusume to grow.
Nishino Flower is full of enthusiasm, and...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'll be in your care starting today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I showed such an embarrassing performance
at the Oaks, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "At the Sprinters Stakes, this time I swear I will live up to your expectations...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could feel Nishino Flower's determination.
However, I was just as fired up as she was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her body is approaching a growth spurt as well,
gradually changing from that of a child
into an adult's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She will finally be able to demonstrate 100% of the physical
abilities enhanced by her Awakening.
From here on, we'll practice while searching for her optimal form—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because you're that kind of Trainer,
I... feel like I want to try even harder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She runs for my sake,
so this time, it's my turn to guide her toward a wonderful future.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Phew, it's so hot, so hot.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look at you two with those serious faces~
Training camp hasn't even started yet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Flower, listen closely.
Can't you hear the sea breeze calling out to us?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Alright, time for a nap on the sand!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A nap!? You have to be careful,
or you'll get heatstroke!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, we still have time, right?
I...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san, wait up!
I brought a cold water bottle
and a picnic mat for us~!
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she helped me relax a little)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling Seiun Sky's kindness,
the heated summer training camp began!
